audio-minute.eventDescription: One started minute of MP3, M4A or WAV output (a 3 min 20 s file is 4 minutes). Failed files are free.

video-480p-minute.eventDescription: One started minute of MP4 or WebM output at up to 480p (e.g. 854x480). Failed files are free.

video-720p-minute.eventDescription: One started minute of MP4 or WebM output at up to 720p (e.g. 1280x720). Failed files are free.

video-1080p-minute.eventDescription: One started minute of MP4 or WebM output at up to 1080p (e.g. 1920x1080), or of any video output from an input above 1080p (e.g. 4K). Failed files are free.
